final: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting that suggests internal cognition through color, contrast, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Use a deep midnight-blue and near-black ground, crossed by restless strokes of hot coral, electric teal, pale ochre, and chalk white. Let dense, dry-brushed marks gather and collide in a loose, off-center spiral of motion, with translucent washes drifting outward and thin scratches interrupting heavier patches. Set abrupt areas of silence against bursts of layered activity; vary the scale and tempo of the brushwork so the surface feels alert, uncertain, and continually rearranging itself. Keep the composition purely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Fill the entire square image with paint, with no border, frame, wall, room, or gallery setting."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
